en: I am an Associate Professor and Deputy Thrust Head of Computational Media and Arts at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), where I lead the FIT-AWE Lab.

I received my PhD in Computer Science from Western University, Canada. Before joining HKUST(GZ) in 2024, I was a Professor of Computing at Xi’an Jiaotong-Liverpool University, where I served as Head of the Department of Computing from 2019 to 2023.
zh: 我是香港科技大学（广州）计算媒体与艺术学域副教授、学域副主任，负责 FIT-AWE 实验室。
我在加拿大西安大略大学获得计算机科学博士学位。2024 年加入香港科技大学（广州）之前，我曾任西交利物浦大学计算学教授，并于 2019 至 2023 年担任计算系系主任。
